model.title: A bill to redesignate a playground in the New River Gorge National Park and Preserve in the State of West Virginia as the "Hearts of Gold Playground: In Honor of West Virginia Children and Families Impacted by Childhood Cancer".
model.meta: Energy and Natural Resources Committee · Sen. James Justice (R-WV)

summary.text: The bill would rename a playground in New River Gorge National Park and Preserve in West Virginia to honor children and families affected by childhood cancer in the state.
